mappings.name: GitHub App: an installation access token for a JWT

metadata.note: GitHub's tokens last an hour. This one lasts four minutes, inside the five the coder refreshes before expiry, so the coder trades a JWT for a token at every use: each run of dev/coder-e2e.sh (which empties the journal first) sees its own trade, and the refresh path is exercised all the time. The coder's tests keep the real cycle (cargo test -p adam-workspace --test github_app).

mappings.name: GitHub App: anything but a JWT is refused

jsonBody.message: A JSON web token could not be decoded
